summary: Horizontal monochrome color bars to the left of a vertical separator bar extend rightward with periodic intervals equal to their pixel count.
src: horizontal monochrome color bars left of the vertical separator bar s
path: straight line from separator bar to the opposite grid edge, perpendicular to separator (rightward)
trajectory: paint s.color at intervals where interval = s.pixel_count
multi_step: Process multiple bars by distance from separator: start with the bar closest to the separator, then proceed outward; do not overwrite previously painted colors
